title: The duplicate-name check in `Records::map` takes 2.2 s on 2.4M targets
body:
`Records::map` in `nail/src/io/records.rs` maps an input with libsail's `Framed::map`, then builds the name index with `framed.name_index()`. It then refuses a file that repeats a record name. For each record `n` it allocates the name as a `String`, looks the name up with `position`, and bails if the first match is not `n`. The check exists because the index libsail replaced refused repeated names, and a lookup by name returns only the first record. The loop runs on one thread.

On the 2,455,940-record mgy target fasta, with a warm page cache on the 16-core box:

| step | seconds |
|---|---|
| `Framed::map` | 0.07 |
| `Framed::map` and `name_index` | 0.87 |
| `Fasta::from_path`, which adds the duplicate check | 3.04 to 3.08 |

The duplicate check costs about 2.2 s, and it is the largest part of the 3.36 s target index in the 8-thread run on the parent issue. The timer is the scratch crate in `tmp-claude/2026-10-14-serial-overhead/index-split`.

## Open

- Whether libsail's name index can report a repeated name while it builds, which would make the loop unnecessary.
- If not, whether the loop can skip the `String` allocation and run over rayon.
